body:
Upgrade the `ag_grid` wrapper from AG Grid 34.3.1 to 36.2.0 and pair integrated charts with AG Charts 14.2.0. Public migration notes for changes to grid DOM structure, overlays, column sizing, saved state, and chart options are in [reflex-dev/reflex#7279](https://github.com/reflex-dev/reflex/pull/7279). Publish that docs page before releasing this change so the changelog's public migration link is available.

Expose the initial-only `suppress_overlays` option. Browser coverage also identified and fixes row-ID callback generation, incorrect pinned-row prop names (with backward-compatible aliases), and backend URL handling that encoded datasource query parameters into the path.

Add a dedicated test app using the supplied `reflex_app` fixture and Playwright. It exercises editing and backend events, selection helpers, sorting/filtering/pagination, pinned rows, all four legacy themes, overlays, CSV export, enterprise grouping, integrated charts, and HTTP-backed infinite/server-side datasources.

Validation:
- 30 Playwright cases passed across development and production builds; review follow-up changes only documentation and removes the redundant version-pin assertion.
- 17 focused unit tests passed after review changes.
- Pre-commit checks: Ruff formatting/lint, codespell, generated stubs, and Pyright.
title: Upgrade AG Grid to 36.2.0 with Playwright regression coverage
